source.name: GAO decision concerning CDC brand-name Palantir procurement

entity.name: Measure Palantir vendor lock-in and procurement concentration
entity.scope: Brand-name requirements, proprietary ontologies, migration costs and contract consolidation
indicators: Brand-name procurement protest involving Gotham and Foundry
Army consolidation of 75 contracts into one enterprise agreement
Workflow dependence on proprietary data models and applications
priority_questions: Can agencies export ontology, lineage, permissions and application logic in usable form?
What are replacement, migration and retraining costs?
How many procurements receive one bid?
Which contract clauses preserve interoperability and termination assistance?
